contribution.position: I hold my position from last round: on reliability grounds this change is not in a good place. The measured p99 latency is 410ms at peak load, 64% over the 250ms budget (artifact:perf-report), and the service has two recent sev2 incidents from retry storms (artifact:incident-log) — the exact failure mode excess latency under load aggravates. The green test suite (artifact:test-report) confirms functional correctness but says nothing about behavior under load, so the reliability evidence on record still points against shipping in the current state until the latency regression is understood or mitigated.
